input_contract: Server-produced confirmed canonical symptoms; not raw text or the V2 feature list.

drooling.required_meaning: More saliva production than usual; drooling alone does not establish increased production.

hoarse_voice.required_meaning: A deeper, softer or hoarse voice; an unspecified voice change is broader.

runny_blocked_nose.required_meaning: Nasal congestion or a clear runny nose; the combined confirmation label does not establish which alternative or discharge characteristic applies.

itchy_eyes.required_meaning: Severe itching in one or both eyes.

heavy_sweating.required_meaning: Significantly increased sweating compared with usual.

loss_of_appetite.required_meaning: Recent appetite loss or becoming full more quickly than usual.

weight_loss.required_meaning: Involuntary weight loss over the last three months.

notes: Supported mappings require confirmation of the reviewed canonical label, including its stated qualifiers.
Broad or fuzzy aliases are recognition suggestions, not independently confirmed evidence.
This definition does not alter the existing V1/V2 catalogue or mappings.
Clarification-required codes remain unsupported even if a particular text phrase might contain additional detail; interpreting that detail is outside this mapper.
Sneezing is absent from the current backend catalogue and remains unmatched wording unless explicitly supported by a later catalogue change.
This issue does not implement follow-up questions or clinical validation.
